title: StudioDash
tagline: Your apps. Your revenue. Your studio. One workspace.

hero.alt: StudioDash developer dashboard showing apps, revenue, analytics and connected services

shortDescription: A developer analytics and business dashboard for independent app developers and small studios.
description: StudioDash is a native developer analytics and business workspace from [BarkinMad Studios](/about), designed for independent developers and small studios. Bring together your app portfolio, revenue, advertising, website analytics, search performance, provider health, reporting, and connected services so you can spend less time switching between dashboards and more time understanding and growing your products.
features: Portfolio dashboard for apps and games
Combined app and advertising revenue reporting
Revenue by app, source, country, and date where available

faq.question: What is StudioDash?
faq.answer: StudioDash is a developer analytics and business dashboard that brings your apps, revenue, advertising, websites, analytics, provider health, and other supported developer services together in one workspace.

faq.question: Who is StudioDash designed for?
faq.answer: StudioDash is designed for independent app and game developers, solo developers, and small studios managing multiple products and the services behind them.

faq.question: Is StudioDash available on the App Store?
faq.answer: Not yet. StudioDash is being prepared for a controlled Private Beta before its wider public release.

faq.question: Which services does StudioDash support?
faq.answer: StudioDash supports a growing range of app, advertising, analytics, website, and search services including App Store Connect, LevelPlay, Google Analytics, Cloudflare, Google Search Console, and Google AdSense. Additional integrations can be added as StudioDash develops.

faq.question: Can StudioDash track revenue from different sources?
faq.answer: Yes. StudioDash can bring supported App Store, advertising, website, and other revenue information together, helping you understand your overall revenue and explore individual apps and sources where detailed information is available.

faq.question: Does StudioDash update automatically?
faq.answer: On Mac, StudioDash can keep supported provider information updated in the background. Manual refresh remains available whenever you want to request the latest available information.

faq.question: What StudioDash plans will be available?
faq.answer: StudioDash is designed around Free, Pro, and Studio plans. Free provides the essentials, while Pro and Studio provide additional analytics, reporting, and business capabilities.

faq.question: Is there a benefit for joining the Private Beta?
faq.answer: Yes. Private Beta participants receive full Studio access during testing. Active beta participants will receive 12 months of Studio at no cost from the public launch date, followed by an exclusive opportunity to purchase Pro or Studio at a discounted beta tester price.
